1	# Trellis — SPEC
     2	
     3	## 1 Purpose
     4	- Trello clone, botanical theme. Kanban usability is mandatory; theming is decoration on top.
     5	- Stack (fixed): Vite + React 18 + TS, Vitest + RTL + jsdom, localStorage persistence, @dnd-kit DnD, CSS/framer-motion animation, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.
     6	
     7	## 2 Botanical vocabulary
     8	
     9	| Trello term | Trellis term |
    10	|---|---|
    11	| Board | Garden |
    12	| List | Bed |
    13	| Card | Seedling |
    14	| Archive (action) | Compost |
    15	| Archived item | Composted |
    16	| Restore (action) | Replant |
    17	| Label | Tag Bloom |
    18	| Checklist | Growth chart |
    19	| Checklist item | Task shoot |
    20	| Comment/activity log | Journal entry |
    21	| Board background/theme | Season |
    22	| Due date | Bloom-by date |
    23	| Search/filter | Prune (filter view) |
    24	
    25	UI copy uses Trellis terms; code identifiers use plain Trello-equivalent English (Board/List/Card) — no botanical names in code, only in user-facing strings.
    26	
    27	## 3 Data model
    28	
    29	```ts
    30	// schema version — bump on breaking shape change, write migration
    31	const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
    32	
    33	type ID = string; // uuid v4
    34	
    35	interface Garden { // Board
    36	  id: ID;
    37	  title: string;
    38	  season: SeasonId; // background/theme
    39	  createdAt: string; // ISO
    40	}
    41	
    42	interface Bed { // List
    43	  id: ID;
    44	  gardenId: ID;
    45	  title: string;
    46	  order: number; // fractional index, see Ordering
    47	  archived: boolean;
    48	}
    49	
    50	// Note: no Garden.archived — brief requires archive/restore for beds and
    51	// seedlings only, not gardens.
    52	
    53	interface Seedling { // Card
    54	  id: ID;
    55	  bedId: ID;
    56	  title: string;
    57	  description: string;
    58	  order: number; // fractional index within bed
    59	  tagIds: ID[];
    60	  dueDate: string | null; // ISO date
    61	  checklist: TaskShoot[];
    62	  journal: JournalEntry[];
    63	  archived: boolean;
    64	  archivedByBed: boolean; // true if archived via bed compost cascade, not directly — see FR-13
    65	  createdAt: string;
    66	}
    67	
    68	interface TaskShoot { // checklist item
    69	  id: ID;
    70	  text: string;
    71	  done: boolean;
    72	}
    73	
    74	interface JournalEntry { // comment/activity
    75	  id: ID;
    76	  type: "comment" | "activity";
    77	  text: string; // comment text, or activity description
    78	  createdAt: string;
    79	}
    80	
    81	interface TagBloom { // Label
    82	  id: ID;
    83	  gardenId: ID;
    84	  name: string;
    85	  color: string; // hex or theme token
    86	}
    87	
    88	type SeasonId = "spring" | "summer" | "autumn" | "winter"; // theme presets
    89	
    90	interface TrellisState {
    91	  version: number;
    92	  gardens: Garden[];
    93	  beds: Bed[];
    94	  seedlings: Seedling[];
    95	  tags: TagBloom[];
    96	}
    97	```
    98	
    99	- **IDs**: `crypto.randomUUID()`.
   100	- **Ordering**: fractional-index float `order` per (bed within garden, seedling within bed). Reorder = recompute sibling's `order` as midpoint; renumber whole set only on float exhaustion (>~15 sig figs).
   101	- **localStorage key**: `trellis:state`.
   102	- **Schema**: single JSON blob = `TrellisState`, `version` field gates migrations (none at v1; unknown/missing version → treat as corrupt, reset to empty state, keep raw value under `trellis:state:corrupt:<ts>` for recovery).
   103	- Archive = soft delete via `archived: true`, not physical deletion.
   104	
   105	## 4 Functional requirements
   106	
   107	**FR-1 Create garden**
   108	- Given the garden list view, When user submits a non-empty title, Then a new Garden is created, persisted, and shown.
   109	- Given empty/whitespace-only title, When submitted, Then rejected, no state change.
   110	
   111	**FR-2 Create bed**
   112	- Given an open garden, When user adds a bed with a title, Then bed appended at end of bed order, persisted.
   113	- Given empty/whitespace-only title, When submitted, Then rejected, no state change.
   114	
   115	**FR-3 Create seedling**
   116	- Given a bed, When user adds a seedling with a title, Then seedling appended at end of that bed, persisted, seedling element carries `data-anim="bloom"` for the animation's duration (absent under reduced-motion).
   117	- Given empty/whitespace-only title, When submitted, Then rejected, no state change.
   118	
   119	**FR-4 Drag-reorder seedling within a bed**
   120	- Given seedlings in a bed, When user drags one to a new position in the same bed, Then its `order` updates to sit between new neighbours, persisted; dragged element carries `data-anim="sway"` for the drag's duration (absent under reduced-motion).
   121	
   122	**FR-5 Drag-move seedling between beds**
   123	- Given seedlings in bed A, When user drags one into bed B at position N, Then `bedId` and `order` update to match, persisted.
   124	
   125	**FR-6 Drag-reorder beds**
   126	- Given beds in a garden, When user drags a bed to a new position, Then bed `order` updates, persisted.
   127	
   128	**FR-7 Card detail modal**
   129	- Given a seedling, When user clicks it, Then modal opens showing title, description, tags, due date, checklist w/ progress, journal.
   130	- When user edits any field in modal, Then change persists on blur/submit without closing modal.
   131	
   132	**FR-8a Manage Tag Blooms**
   133	- Given a garden, When user creates a tag with name + colour, Then it's added to that garden's tag set, persisted, available to apply.
   134	- Given a garden's tag set, When user edits a tag's name/colour, Then all seedlings using it reflect the change; When user deletes a tag, Then it's removed from the set and unassigned from all seedlings, persisted.
   135	
   136	**FR-8 Tag colours**
   137	- Given modal open, When user adds/removes a tag on the seedling, Then tag chip (with colour) reflects immediately on both modal and board card.
   138	
   139	**FR-9 Due date**
   140	- Given modal open, When user sets a due date, Then card shows due-date badge; overdue (`dueDate` < today, regardless of checklist state) badge visually distinct and has `data-overdue="true"`.
   141	
   142	**FR-10 Checklist**
   143	- Given modal open, When user adds/checks/unchecks/deletes a task shoot, Then growth-chart progress bar updates (animated fill), persisted.
   144	
   145	**FR-11 Comments/activity**
   146	- Given modal open, When user posts a comment, Then journal entry appended with timestamp, persisted; system also auto-logs activity entries (create/move/archive) as `type: "activity"`.
   147	
   148	**FR-12 Archive/restore card**
   149	- Given a seedling, When user composts it, Then `archived: true`, removed from board view after its element carries `data-anim="wilt"` for the animation's duration (skipped under reduced-motion).
   150	- Given archive view, When user replants a composted seedling, Then `archived: false`, reappears in original bed at end of order.
   151	
   152	**FR-13 Archive/restore list**
   153	- Given a bed, When user composts it, Then bed `archived: true`; each currently-unarchived seedling in it gets `archived: true, archivedByBed: true` (seedlings already archived individually are left as-is).
   154	- Given a composted bed, When user replants it, Then bed `archived: false`; only seedlings with `archivedByBed: true` are restored (`archived: false, archivedByBed: false`) — seedlings archived individually before the bed was composted stay archived.
   155	
   156	**FR-14 Search/filter**
   157	- Given a garden with seedlings, When user types in search box, Then only seedlings whose title/description match (case-insensitive substring) remain visible; beds with no matches shown empty (not hidden).
   158	- Given tag filter selection, When one or more tags selected, Then only seedlings having any selected tag are visible; combines with text search (AND).
   159	
   160	**FR-15 Board background/theme (Season) picker**
   161	- Given garden settings, When user picks a season, Then garden's `season` updates, background/palette changes immediately, persisted.
   162	
   163	**FR-16 Persistence across reload**
   164	- Given any state change, When page is reloaded, Then all gardens/beds/seedlings/tags/journal restored exactly as last saved.
   165	
   166	## 5 Theme & animation spec
   167	
   168	| Trigger | Animation | Duration | Reduced-motion fallback |
   169	|---|---|---|---|
   170	| Seedling created | Bloom (scale 0.8→1 + fade + petal-pop) | 300ms | Instant fade-in, 0ms |
   171	| Seedling composted (archived) | Wilt (rotate/droop + fade + desaturate) | 400ms | Instant fade-out, 0ms |
   172	| Seedling dragged | Sway (subtle rotate ±3deg loop) | continuous while dragging | No sway; static lift shadow only |
   173	| Seedling dropped | Settle (slight overshoot bounce) | 200ms | No bounce; instant snap |
   174	| Checklist progress change | Growth-chart bar fill (vine-grow width transition) | 250ms | Instant width change |
   175	| Bed reordered | Slide to new slot | 200ms | Instant reposition |
   176	| Garden season change | Palette crossfade | 300ms | Instant swap |
   177	| Modal open/close | Grow from card / shrink to card | 250ms | Instant show/hide |
   178	| Tag added | Chip pop-in | 150ms | Instant appear |
   179	
   180	- All durations/animations gated by `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` — CSS media query or JS `matchMedia` check; reduced-motion path = 0ms/instant per row above.
   181	- Testable hook: the animating element carries `data-anim="<name>"` (e.g. `bloom`, `wilt`, `sway`) for the animation's duration; attribute absent/omitted when reduced-motion is active. Applies to every row above with a named animation.
   182	
   183	## 6 Non-functional
   184	
   185	- **Persistence**: write-through to localStorage on every state mutation (debounced ~100ms ok); load on app init; corrupt/missing data → empty state, never crash.
   186	- **A11y**: keyboard DnD alternative (@dnd-kit keyboard sensor) for reorder/move; focus trap in modal; `aria-label`s on icon-only buttons; colour not sole means of tag/due-date meaning (also text/icon).
   187	- **Perf**: not covered by unit tests (jsdom has no real paint/frame timing) — verify manually/Lighthouse. Boundary-testable proxy: board with 10 beds x 50 seedlings, dragging a seedling to a new position leaves sibling seedlings' DOM node identity unchanged (same node via `data-testid`/ref, not re-created).
   188	
   189	## 7 Out of scope
   190	- Multi-user, auth, backend/sync, real-time collab.
   191	- Card attachments/file upload.
   192	- Board templates, power-ups/plugins.
   193	- Undo/redo beyond archive-restore.
   194	- Mobile-native app (responsive web only, no native gestures beyond dnd-kit touch support).
   195	- Export/import.

The run proved functional correctness, not visual completion. The evidence supports the user’s report.

1. What it missed—and how it passed

- The spec requires a botanical themed UI and nine animation behaviors, with reduced-motion handling ([SPEC §5](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/SPEC.md:166)). The CSS inventory records only 145 CSS lines total, including 12 theme lines, and shows three components with no `className` at all ([css inventory](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/css-inventory.txt:1)).
- The completeness review explicitly found missing animation CSS for bloom, wilt, sway, settle, bed-slide, and pop-in, plus no visual overdue state ([workflow log](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:345)).
- This was allowed through because the plan reviewer still returned `changes_required` for animation ownership, but the orchestrator accepted the two important residuals and deferred them; it also records that the actionable-findings script bug was fixed only after that run had used the old version ([workflow log](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:72)).
- Final verification was only `npm test`, TypeScript, and build ([workflow log](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:359)). The reported result likewise contains only those checks and `16/16 review pass or fixed`; it has no visual-acceptance criterion ([result.json](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/result.json:1)).

2. Time and usage concentration

I summed the CSV’s `dur_s`, `cache_read`, `cache_create`, and `out_tok` columns ([agents.csv schema](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/agents.csv:1)):

| Area | Agent time | Cache read | Cache create | Output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Whole run | 11,220 s / 187.0 min | 100.42M | 5.97M | 71,381 |
| Implementation phase | 7,169 s / 119.5 min (64%) | 80.73M (80%) | 3.20M (54%) | 40,125 (56%) |
| Final fixer alone | 2,085 s / 34.8 min | 37.15M | 451,979 | 11,442 |

The final fixer was the largest single consumer ([agents.csv](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/agents.csv:78)); the next was `implementer-T9` at 1,116 s and 12.60M cache-read tokens ([agents.csv](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/agents.csv:82)). The session’s logged wall clock runs from 09:07:22Z to 11:18:39Z—about 2 h 11 m ([start](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:1), [end](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:363)). No dollar pricing or model rate is present, so a monetary cost cannot be derived.

3. What was dropped from the delivered result

`result.json` says `"residual": null` ([result.json](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/result.json:1)). But the final orchestrator entry records residual “bed-reorder anim, overdue CSS, renumber unused” ([workflow log](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:363)). Those residuals were silently absent from the reported result.

Also, tests/build were green before the final fixer logged tag-chip and animation-gap work ([workflow log](/home/mark/.claude/jobs/1fc6d338/tmp/evals/red-20260831T140000Z-C-codex-attempt-1/run-dir/workflow-log.jsonl:354)), and the subsequent verifier again checked only tests/typecheck/build. There is no logged visual review after those changes.

4. Next-run shape

- Make theme/CSS and every §5 animation row first-class planned deliverables, with a single owner and explicit CSS/file acceptance criteria.
- Do not proceed when a plan reviewer returns `changes_required`; fix or explicitly carry each issue into the final result.
- Add a final visual acceptance stage after all fixes: inspect rendered states for each season, overdue badge, modal, tag chip, and each animation/reduced-motion path.
- Make the final report reconcile against the completeness findings and include every residual; do not permit `residual: null` while the workflow log retains residual defects.
- Keep functional tests/build gates, but label them accurately as functional/build verification rather than completion of the themed UI.
